The other carriers are byte-identical. The replay still asserts the sent-feedback replay flags [true,false] and the export-policy pair still decides the wire output, so the re-advertisement of the requested <AFI, SAFI> Adj-RIB-Out under outbound policy stays proven in both polarities. Verdict unchanged: enforced. Earlier judgement follows. Independently rejudged 2026-10-22; no execution or stamping. RFC 2918 Section 4: "Otherwise, the BGP speaker shall re-advertise to that peer the Adj-RIB-Out of the <AFI, SAFI> carried in the message, based on its outbound route filtering policy." Read every tagged carrier: internal/component/bgp/plugins/rib/rfc2918_config_static_test.go::TestRFC2918ConfigStaticRetainedForRefresh and TestRFC2918RefreshDoesNotSendToDownPeer; rib/rib_test.go::TestHandleRefresh_InternalState and TestHandleRefresh_PeerNotUp; reactor/rfc2918_replay_feedback_test.go::TestRefreshSentFeedbackRetainsReplayOrigin and TestRFC2918RefreshRunsCurrentExportPolicy; test/plugin/refresh-config-static.ci. The changed policy setup constructs ExportPolicy with the same refresh-policy reference and explicit FinalAccept, then republishes forwarding facts. The accepted replay must grow the wire output and call the policy once; changing only the policy response to reject must call it again and leave wire bytes identical. Both polarities isolate current export policy rather than final exhaustion. The immediate/queued replay test asserts sent-feedback replay flags [true,false], and storage tests consume emitted commands through the real UPDATE parser, require exact requested-family route identities and configured attributes, retain config-static ownership on refresh and transfer it on an ordinary plugin replacement. The functional carrier pins the exact configured IPv4 UPDATE before and after an actual AFI 1/SAFI 1 refresh, bracketed by BoRR/EoRR. Producer/consumer read: rib_structured.go::dispatchStructured routes refresh to handleRefreshStructured, which checks subtype and established peer then collects only the requested Adj-RIB-Out family; rib_commands.go::sendRoutes supplies replay metadata; reactor/egress_inject_filter.go::exportFilterForBody reads the current export Policy and rejects before transmission. TestHandleRefresh_PeerNotUp alone asserts only the unchanged down state and is not evidence of no output; the separate TestRFC2918RefreshDoesNotSendToDownPeer explicitly fails on either route or marker emission, so the whole row retains its existing enforced verdict without inflating that older carrier. Native renewal inputs are freshness observations, not this semantic verdict.
